newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ex-Nomura chief to be questioned in parliament.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Nomura chief to be questioned in parliament.

text.p: The former president of Nomura Securities Co Ltd, Hideo Sakamaki, will answer questions at a finance committee meeting of Japan's Lower House of parliament on Friday, a parliament official said on Tuesday.

Sakamaki stepped down from the president's post last month to take managerial responsibility for a scandal involving suspected illegal deals, which included transferring money from a Nomura account to a corporate client's account.

Prosecutors and officials from Japan's securities watchdog raided Nomura on March 25 in a widening proble into Nomura's role in payments to the corporate client, who has been linked to a "sokaiya" racketeer.
